step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays TXCraft's high-concurrency ticket sales system. Traffic enters through an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) which distributes requests across UI layer EC2 instances (On-Demand and Spot instances managed via Auto Scaling). These UI instances push ticket purchase requests to Amazon DynamoDB. On the backend, a second layer of API EC2 instances (On-Demand and Spot instances, managed by Auto Scaling) handles backend processing, fetching tasks from and writing results back to DynamoDB.
